title: Crispy Italian Chicken Cutlet
description: A classic Italian dish made with crispy chicken cutlets and a crunchy topping.
instructions: 2. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, italian seasonings, and a pinch of salt.
3. In a separate dish, beat the eggs.
4. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
5. Coat the chicken breasts in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
6. Dip the floured chicken breasts in the beaten eggs, making sure they're fully coated.
7. Roll the egg-coated chicken breasts in the crunchy topping to coat.
8. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
9. Add the coated chicken breasts to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
10. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
11. While the chicken is baking, slice the challot into thin rounds.
12. Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and top each cutlet with a few slices of challot and a sprinkle of crumble.
